en: This is an old black-and-white postcard featuring a photograph of a large, elegant building with pointed spires, surrounded by a formal garden with a large tree and a decorative fountain. A person is seen walking along a path in the foreground. The printed text on the front reads 'Bad Pyrmont Schlossstrasse.' The reverse side contains handwritten text in German, a printed 'Postkarte' header, old German handwriting, a green 5 Pfennig 'Deutsches Reich' stamp, and postmarks indicating the date and mailing locations.
